title: LOX-side turbopump bearing race micro-pitting after hot-fire
description: Post-test borescope inspection of LOX-side turbopump bearing race on EA-1 unit 019 revealed micro-pitting and carbon deposits exceeding spec along the inner race. 18-second hot-fire on Stand 4 produced a vibration excursion of 2.7 sigma at T+0.9s on the high-pressure ox shaft. Bearing race material consistent with Acme Bearings AB-7821 batch 23Q1. Root cause attributed to upstream LOX contamination interacting with bearing race surface finish below print tolerance.

title: Repeat LOX bearing race carbon deposit, EA-1 unit 022
description: Recurrence of carbon-deposit signature on LOX-side turbopump bearing race during EA-1 unit 022 acceptance hot-fire. 14-second burn on Hot-fire Stand 4. Vibration shifted 3.1 sigma at T+0.6s. Micro-pitting morphology on inner race matches the EA1-019 pattern. Bearing race traceable to Acme Bearings AB-7821 batch 24Q1 — produced prior to the metallurgical re-cert that was issued internally in late 2023.

title: LH-0 turbopump bearing race carbon residue, low severity
description: Routine borescope on LH-0 unit 031 after sub-orbital flight cadence work showed light carbon residue and incipient micro-pitting on the LH2-side turbopump bearing race. Vibration trace within nominal envelope. Bearing race traceable to Acme Bearings AB-7831 batch 23Q3. Triaged as LH-0-specific operational wear; closed without cross-program propagation review.

title: EA-1 unit 027 LOX bearing race carbon deposit, vibration excursion
description: Carbon deposits exceed spec on LOX-side turbopump bearing race during 14-second hot-fire test on 2026-06-12T06:14:00Z. Vibration signature shifted by 3.2 sigma at T+0.7s on the high-pressure oxidizer shaft. Bearing race showed micro-pitting consistent with debris from upstream contamination, morphology near-identical to the EA1-019 and EA1-022 incidents. Bearing race batch under traceability pull — Acme Bearings AB-7821 family. Stand 4 instrumentation nominal; LOX prevalve and feedline witness samples taken.

title: Combustion instability at chamber wall, EA-1 unit 014
description: Acoustic mode shifted into the 1T tangential band at T+3.2s during hot-fire of EA-1 unit 014. Chamber pressure oscillation peaked at 8% pc, transient. Chamber wall thermal barrier coating showed local spallation post-test. Attributed to oxidizer pre-burner injector face cooling deficiency; injector pattern redesigned and validated on unit 015.

title: Nozzle throat erosion exceeding service envelope, EA-1 unit 016
description: Post-test inspection of carbon-carbon nozzle throat insert on EA-1 unit 016 measured 0.42 mm of erosion vs 0.30 mm service limit after 28-second hot-fire. No combustion anomaly observed during burn. Root cause traced to insert resin density at the lower control limit. Vector Nozzle batch pull issued.

title: Main oxidizer valve sluggish open transient
description: MOV open-transient time on EA-1 unit 018 measured 142 ms vs spec 110 ms during chill-down rehearsal. Helium-side actuator pilot pressure within limits. Replaced MOV actuator, transient came back to 108 ms. Spare valve quarantined for Titan Valve teardown.

title: Oxidizer pre-burner ignition delay 80 ms over nominal
description: Oxidizer pre-burner ignition delay on EA-1 unit 020 measured 80 ms over the rolling-30 nominal. No downstream consequence; full chamber-pressure ramp on schedule. Filed for pattern tracking against Polaris igniter cartridge batch.

title: TVC gimbal actuator hysteresis above print
description: Static-fire gimbal sweep on EA-1 unit 024 revealed hysteresis on the +Y TVC actuator 0.18 deg above the 0.10 deg spec. Northstar root-caused to a vendor seal lot in the actuator cylinder; replaced and re-tested clean.

title: LOX tank dome forging surface anomaly
description: Receiving NDT on Atlas Tankage LOX tank dome forging for EA-1 unit 025 found a 4 mm linear indication on the outer dome surface. Indication characterized non-relevant after eddy-current re-scan and grind-blend; release on concession.

title: LOX feedline witness-sample particulate trace
description: Post-flush witness sample on the LOX feedline for EA-1 unit 026 returned 2 particles >150 um — within concession limit (3) but above 30-day rolling mean. No flight delta. Tagged for trend-tracking against upstream cleanliness audits.

title: Thrust-chamber telemetry conditioner bit-error spike
description: Thrust-chamber telemetry conditioner reported BER above mask for 1.4s during cold-soak rehearsal. Conditioner FPGA bit-flip suspected. Lakeside Avionics released a configuration patch; re-test clean.

title: Main injector element fuel-side erosion pattern
description: Borescope of main injector element on EA-1 unit 021 showed mild fuel-side erosion of element 47, within acceptance envelope. No chamber-pressure anomaly during burn. Annotated against Summit Injector batch 24Q1.

title: Oxidizer pre-burner injector face thermal mark
description: Post-test inspection of OPB injector face on EA-1 unit 028 showed thermal discoloration ring around the center element. Within acceptance per the post-2023 redesign. Flagged for trend-pile only.

title: Cryogenic A286 fastener torque scatter
description: Cryogenic A286 fastener torque audit on EA-1 unit 023 thrust-structure showed 12% scatter against 8% control band. Sigma Fasteners batch traced; replaced bolts and re-torqued.

title: Helium isolation valve leakage at 22 bar
description: Helium pressurant isolation valve on EA-1 unit 013 measured 8 sccm leakage at 22 bar vs 5 sccm acceptance. Below safety threshold but flagged; Titan Valve TV-5510 batch annotated.

title: Chamber-wall thermal barrier coating thickness drift
description: Coating thickness on EA-1 unit 017 chamber wall measured 0.62 mm vs 0.70 mm nominal target on the +Z circumferential band. Horizon Ceramic process drift on the deposition fixture; re-strip and re-apply on next unit.

title: LH-0 helium pressurant bottle composite-overwrap fiber-burst margin
description: Acceptance proof on LH-0 helium pressurant composite-overwrap bottle for unit 024 came in at 1.38x rated burst vs 1.50x design margin. Pacific Pressurant root-caused to filament-winding tension drift; bottle rejected, replacement unit accepted at 1.55x.

title: Spark-torch igniter erosion within service envelope
description: LH-0 unit 026 spark-torch igniter assembly showed expected ring erosion at the end of service interval. No replacement required; logged for cumulative life tracking against Polaris PI-1201.

title: LH-0 nozzle throat insert localized hot streak
description: Post-flight inspection of LH-0 unit 032 carbon-carbon nozzle throat revealed a localized hot streak at the 220 deg azimuth. Vector Nozzle pulled witness coupon; root cause attributed to a corner-of-print resin density. Closed with batch acceptance re-scope.

title: LH-0 cryogenic prevalve open transient slow
description: Cryogenic prevalve open transient on LH-0 unit 034 measured 8 ms over print at LOX-side. Ironwood Cryo replaced actuator solenoid; re-transient nominal.

title: LH-0 turbopump labyrinth seal end-of-life inspection
description: Routine teardown of LH-0 unit 036 turbopump revealed expected wear pattern on the labyrinth seal. No leak path; logged against Merlin Seals service-life dataset.

title: LH-0 ablative liner end-of-life recession beyond mean
description: LH-0 unit 038 ablative liner end-of-life inspection measured 1.1 mm recession on the +Y stripe vs 0.9 mm rolling mean. Aerojet Composites batch under recent transition; closed within service envelope.

title: SL1-23 booster nozzle structural failure during ascent
description: Booster nozzle structural failure observed at T+65s during SL1-23 uncrewed sub-orbital launch. Capsule abort triggered nominally. FAA mishap investigation found root cause in nozzle internal fatigue exacerbated by higher-than-expected operating temperatures and led to 21 corrective actions across organization and procedures.

title: NS return-to-flight IMU bias drift during pre-flight checkout
description: IMU bias drift on NS return-to-flight checkout exceeded 30-day calibration threshold by 4 ucr/h. Lakeside Avionics calibrated against bench standard; cleared. Recorded in post-RTF anomaly log.

title: SL1-25 RCS gimbal small-angle command jitter
description: RCS gimbal small-angle command jitter on SL1-25 measured 0.04 deg vs 0.02 deg objective during pre-flight. Within control authority; closed without rework.

title: SL1-26 capsule docking ring fastener tension check failure
description: Capsule docking ring fastener tension check on SL1-26 returned 2 bolts below the lower control limit. Sigma Fasteners audit cleared, re-torqued to limit. Pre-flight close-out OK.

title: SL1-27 helium pressurant composite bottle thermal cycle warmth
description: SL1-27 helium pressurant composite-overwrap bottle came out of thermal cycle 6 deg warmer than rolling mean. Within spec; Pacific Pressurant batch logged.

title: SL1-28 spark-torch igniter low ionization current pulse
description: SL1-28 spark-torch igniter showed a single low-ionization current pulse during ignition train test. Subsequent pulses nominal; closed with no action.

title: Second-stage methane tank dome forging weld inspection finding
description: Second-stage methane tank dome weld on HL1-1 returned a 7 mm linear UT indication near the +Z forging interface. Atlas Tankage repair procedure executed; post-repair NDT clean. Filed against weld-procedure qualification.

title: TVC gimbal actuator pre-load drift on HL1-1 second stage
description: Pre-load on the second-stage HL1-1 TVC gimbal actuator drifted 3% over 14-day storage. Northstar replaced spring; re-cal nominal.

title: Second-stage chamber liner post-cure dimensional drift
description: Second-stage HL1-2 combustion chamber liner came off post-cure 0.4 mm thick on the throat-circumferential band. Aerojet Composites adjusted mandrel offset; next-article inspection clean.

title: Main fuel valve seat leakage at proof pressure
description: HL1-2 main fuel valve returned 22 sccm seat leakage at proof pressure vs 10 sccm acceptance. Titan Valve TV-5612 seat rework on bench; post-rework 4 sccm — accepted.

title: Vacuum-jacketed LOX feedline annulus vacuum decay
description: Vacuum annulus on HL1-2 vacuum-jacketed LOX feedline decayed 4 millitorr/day vs 2 millitorr/day rolling mean. Within acceptance; Ironwood Cryo trend-pile.

title: Forward-skirt fastener cryogenic torque retention
description: HL1-3 forward-skirt cryogenic A286 fastener torque retention came out 11% scatter vs 8% control band. Sigma Fasteners batch under review; replacement bolts on order.

title: HL1-3 IMU thermal-stabilization time exceeded
description: HL1-3 IMU thermal-stabilization time during pre-flight rehearsal exceeded the 12-min objective by 90s. Lakeside Avionics adjusted heater map; subsequent runs in spec.

title: Second-stage nozzle extension skirt brazing inspection finding
description: Brazing joint on HL1-3 second-stage nozzle extension skirt showed 3 mm wetting deficit at one circumferential location. Vector Nozzle reworked; post-rework dye-pen clean.

title: Oxidizer pre-burner injector face inspection on HL1-4
description: Receiving inspection of OPB injector face for HL1-4 returned acceptable but on the lower control limit for cooling-passage roundness. Summit Injectors process review opened for trend; passed for use.

title: Methane-side turbopump bearing race vibration excursion
description: HL1-4 methane-side turbopump returned a 2.4 sigma vibration excursion at T+1.1s during chill-down rehearsal. No teardown yet; bearing race traceable to Acme Bearings AB-7822 batch family overlap with the EA-1 LOX-side issue under investigation.

title: the Lunar Module Mk2 dry-mass margin below program threshold
description: the Lunar Module Mk2 lander dry-mass margin trended below the 8% program threshold at the PDR-plus-12-month checkpoint. Two structural sub-system mass roll-ups under refactor; RFA LM1-RFA-014 references this against the propulsion-maturity gate.

title: Descent engine propulsion-maturity gate slip
description: the Lunar Module Mk2 descent engine propulsion-maturity gate slipped 90 days against the PDR-plus-12-month forecast. Engine heritage shares the turbopump bearing race architecture with EA-1 / LH-0 — open RFA LM1-RFA-018 ties this to supplier metallurgical re-cert status.

title: Propellant-margin trend below crew-rated allocation
description: Propellant-margin trend for the Lunar Module Mk2 descent profile crept 2.4% below crew-rated allocation under updated lunar dust environment assumptions. RFA LM1-RFA-021 opened against propulsion + ascent-vehicle interface.

title: LH-0 cryogenic prevalve seat scratch
description: Receiving inspection on Ironwood Cryo prevalve for LH-0 unit 028 found a 0.6 mm seat scratch outside cosmetic acceptance. Replaced from spares; supplier process review.

title: Cryogenic interpropellant seal helium leak trace
description: Helium leak trace measured 12 sccm on Merlin Seals interpropellant seal during EA-1 sub-assembly proof. Below 20 sccm reject limit; flagged on trend register.
